cast_intro: Three new characters in the three styles, each from one sentence, made by the pipeline as it stands after this round - the reference checked, the arms cut free and checked, the UVs repaired, the rig's rules for garments applied. Left to right: the video is the game rig walking, waving and turning; below it the reference, the model at rest and the model mid-jump.
joins_left: The cut starts a quarter of the way down the upper arm and is checked slab by slab; a join still survives somewhere on Pip, Mara, Juno, Rowan, Wren, Vex, Knight, Kaito, Bo, and there the rig keeps that side of the garment with the arm as before.

cast.name: Knight
cast.prompt: a young knight in dented steel plate armour over a blue surcoat, short blond hair, leather gloves and brown leather boots
cast.notes: Three failures on the way, each now a rule: macOS stopped his 3D model on the GPU (it is evaluated in smaller pieces now); his armour's texture failed the web build's quality gate (it steps up the quality instead); and TRELLIS built the picture's backdrop into his model as a board, which the later stages cut into grey sheets hanging from his arms - made again through TRELLIS's own background remover, it has none. Last, his face: his picture's would not lie on his model's, and went on unaligned with every feature twice; his generator's own face is kept now, and with eyes it can find, the face stage gave him blinks and a jaw.

cast.name: Kaito
cast.prompt: an anime ninja boy with spiky black hair, a long red scarf, a fitted dark blue jacket with a belt, black trousers wrapped at the shins and split-toe boots
cast.notes: His first model was 40 pieces: the picture's backdrop built into it as a board through his legs (front match 0.35), his boots' inner toes and hair spikes detached. Made again from the picture with its background cut away (0.91), it is one solid - 7 specks of 80 vertices ride with the part nearest them - and his open sandals have whole toes.

cast.name: Bo
cast.prompt: a cheerful cartoon chef with a tall white chef's hat, round glasses and a thick moustache, a white double-breasted chef jacket, black-and-white checked trousers and red clogs
cast.notes: His first reference had his fists on his hips; the model fused them and shredded his hands at his belt. The new reference check rejects that picture and draws him again.

feet.note: Where her feet run off the bottom of the video's frame, the video cannot say where the floor is, and the retarget's planting is kept: that stretch is the 1.9 cm left.

prompts.scout: a boy scout, fit and energetic, light skin, short brown hair, cheeky grin and bright blue eyes, wearing a blue scout uniform shirt, khaki scout shorts and brown leather scout shoes, with a yellow scout neckerchief and a small blue badge
prompts.board_note: Made again from the picture with its background cut away, all four match: Knight 0.92, Kaito 0.91, Gray 0.93, the boy scout 0.91.
prompts.after_note: Made again with each prompt written out. "A boy scout" is a boy now, 1.20 m, in the scout's blue shirt and yellow neckerchief. "Gray alien, extremely muscular" is clothed and coloured, his 3D model whole (0.93 against his picture instead of a board), and his hands are his own grey and as broad as his forearms - at first the hand step gave him a person's peach hand, small on a forearm twice its width. His all-black outfit is the older prompt model's choice (What is left).

hands_note: Re-scored on 26 September after the rebuilds, with the median beside each mean. Aoi's mean is carried by 21 frames (53% of it) where the pose model reads the light cuff of her jacket sleeve, sticking out past a strongly bent elbow, as her hand - her own hands are where the video's are; see What is left.
